contradictions.finding: The registered root-average output defines a policy only for the selected source learner hole, while E0/E1 draw full joint deals and do not define candidate behavior for other actor holes.
contradictions.consequence: Held-out uplift and sampled-BR profiles are not unique probability laws.
contradictions.required_future_resolution: Separate source-hole-conditional value evaluation from full-joint sampled-BR evaluation and define a complete candidate root table with explicit H11 fallback.

contradictions.finding: The registered sampled-BR-gap formula does not state that the two terms use player0 and player1 utility respectively and does not enumerate the H11/candidate by BR-player fit/eval maps.
contradictions.consequence: The second zero-sum term can have the wrong sign and the fit/eval workload cannot be reconstructed.
contradictions.required_future_resolution: Use E[u0(BR0,sigma1)]+E[u1(sigma0,BR1)], freeze four profile-player BR maps per selected profile, and score each only on its disjoint evaluation split.

contradictions.finding: The 262144-hand deck permutations, player policy uniforms, counter mapping and selection-hash namespace have no identity-bound seeds or exact conversion rule.
contradictions.consequence: The learner-reached root population and selected 64 roots are not reproducible.
contradictions.required_future_resolution: Freeze identity-derived SHA256 counter namespaces, unbiased deck shuffling, policy-uniform conversion and selection hashing before census.

contradictions.finding: Evaluation roles are not enumerated and the registration omits exact upper counts for canonical census calls, likelihood calls, profile replays and two-player BR fit/eval.
contradictions.consequence: The mandated exact-work resource projection cannot be independently audited.
contradictions.required_future_resolution: Freeze a role table and exact upper formulas/counts for every model call, traversal, continuation and serialized record.

contradictions.finding: The registration says legal-mask softmax and CPU-float64 log probability but does not define whether float32 softmax or float64 logits-logsumexp is authoritative or how the sampling CDF is formed.
contradictions.consequence: Root generation and history likelihood can again implement numerically different behavior policies, repeating the I00 failure mechanism.
contradictions.required_future_resolution: Freeze one logits-to-probability-to-CDF routine, runtime versions and final-CDF rule used by both generation and likelihood.

contradictions.finding: The registered Hajek root average does not identify which of the two independent traverser samples updates the acting player's root table.
contradictions.consequence: Snapshot policy identity is not unique.
contradictions.required_future_resolution: Use only the root actor's own traversal draw and require equality to an independently recomputed visit-sampled reference.

why_preimplementation_audit_pass_does_no: The C1 audit checked registered text predicates and hashes. It did not independently instantiate the estimands, role table or exact probability laws. The later red-team review is stronger contradictory evidence and freezes the registration before implementation.

judgment.scientific_authority: It proves only that this exact F64 registration is undefined and cannot be executed.
judgment.route_effect: The exact-V5.5 teacher family remains open. Re-rank within the family to a materially revised F64R1 registration that uniquely fixes all six contradictions before implementation.
